name: Realtime transcription sessions
summary: Dedicated Realtime WebSocket sessions for streaming transcription only (no assistant response); `model` nested under `session.audio.input.transcription.model` (e.g. `gpt-realtime-whisper`).
description: The Realtime API supports transcription-only sessions where the caller streams audio and receives partial/final transcripts, without a chat model responding. The transcription model is specified deep inside the session config as `session.audio.input.transcription.model` (typically `gpt-realtime-whisper`). This is a very different `model` placement from the top-level slot the BYOM prefix normally targets, so even if Foundry's realtime plumbing supports BYOM for the conversational session, the nested transcription model may not honor a `{connection}/{deployment}` prefix.
notes: Status-only. Split out of the `byom-incompatible-endpoints` realtime rollup so the specific nested-`model` question can be tracked separately from the mainline realtime chat session.
